theorems.name: Submission.variation_matrix_det_derivatives_at_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (G : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ), G 0 = 1 → (∀ G₁ : Matrix ι ι ℝ, (∀ i k, HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ G t i k) (G₁ i k) 0) → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ (G t).det) G₁.trace 0) ∧ ∀ (G' : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (G₂ : Matrix ι ι ℝ), (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, ∀ i k, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ G s i k) (G' t i k) t) → (∀ i k, HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ G' t i k) (G₂ i k) 0) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s ↦ (G s).det) t) ∧ HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t ↦ (G t).det)) (G₂.trace + (G' 0).trace ^ 2 - (G' 0 * G' 0).trace) 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
